tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5
tables.text_helper: Table 516, "Effect of low-power modes on TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5", in section 54.4.29 (TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5 low-power modes) on page 2702. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s).

rows:
No effect, peripheral is active. The interrupts can cause the device to exit from Sleep 
mode.

The timer operation is stopped and the register content is kept. No interrupt can be 
generated.
The timer is powered-down and must be reinitialized after exiting the Standby mode.
